Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of SCHW.
We delivered record revenue of $15.2 billion this quarter, representing 5% year-over-year growth.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2022.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $2.77 per share.
Revenue guidance of $15.2 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. Our cloud segment grew 5% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 5% to 10% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
